annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/655 of 19 December 2016 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 with regard to monitoring of gaseous pollutant emissions from in-service internal combustion engines installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/655 on monitoring of gaseous pollutant emissions from in-service internal combustion engines installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 102
annotation.summary_en: EU delegated regulation setting detailed rules for in-service monitoring of gaseous pollutant emissions from Stage V internal combustion engines in non-road mobile machinery, using portable emission measurement systems. It covers engine selection, testing schemes, procedures, data handling and reporting. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Engine manufacturers must monitor in-service Stage V NRE-v-5 and NRE-v-6 engines using PEMS.
Manufacturers submit monitoring plans for approval authority sign-off before testing.
Two testing schemes: Emission Durability Period-based or 4-year period, with reduced numbers for small-volume manufacturers.
Test data must be retained for 10 years and reported per Appendix 8.
ECU data access must follow ISO 27145 or SAE J1939-73.
